payload.title: Run outcomes follow-up: asked and nothing come from real paths; rung and responsibility are written
payload.description:
**Problem.** PPY-f58445 (closed) gave every run an outcome word, but `asked` is only set if a procedure declares it: the real review-request path still ends `acted`. No shipped procedure declares `nothing`. `responsibility` and `rung` are fields that nothing writes. Closed early; filed here, not reopened.

**Change.** `asked` comes from the review-request path (the code that files a review request), not from a procedure's own word. `nothing` is produced by a real procedure path that finds nothing to do and records a reason. `rung` is written (shared with the runner-reads-policy task; this task owns the outcome side).

**Acceptance criteria**
- A run that files a review request ends `asked`, set by the review-request code.
- At least one shipped procedure ends `nothing` with a reason when it has nothing to do (the rating procedure will use it).
- `responsibility` and `rung` are written on every run record (with the policy-read task).
- The Today/console outcome display is covered by the icon task, not here.
- Alternatively the `asked` line is made an explicit acceptance line of PPY-611397 (E2), which already says 'the run ends asked'; whichever is chosen is written on both tasks.

**Gherkin features needed**
- run-outcome-paths.feature: 'a run that files a review request ends asked'; 'a procedure with nothing to do ends nothing with a reason'; 'a run records its responsibility and rung'. Through the runner entry point.

**Dependencies:** blocks PPY-d85860 (rating agent must declare `acted` or `nothing`). Relates PPY-f58445, PPY-611397.

**Report:** papyrus-track-report-1.md, section 1 (#1625 row; follow-up 2).
